learner_operation: Rearrange/separate the ODE, integrate, and where given use initial data to choose the constant and branch; enter the expression requested by its scaffold or select the relation satisfying both ODE and IC.

fixed_features.feature: First-order separable ODE and elementary antiderivatives, source response scaffold and difficulty
fixed_features.justification: Tutorial 974 separates, integrates, substitutes initial data. Radio and blank forms are captured in the 26 sources.

fixed_features.feature: Trig positive-sine interval and log(sin(x-h)) plus quadratic antiderivative
fixed_features.justification: q-104065 explicitly assumes 0<x<pi and derives ln(sin x)+4x²+C; translation and small linear coefficients preserve that method.

fixed_features.feature: Other source profiles use simultaneous coordinate translations
fixed_features.justification: Preserves exact observed integration methods/workload for finite modest numerical practice. Reused prior analysis does not claim these fixed source constants cover every possible initial-condition decision.

answer_roles.role: Correct trig bank option, quadratic coefficient and constant
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any candidate satisfying the displayed ODE and IC may win; zero/nonzero constant and pi/no-pi terms need not be tied to correctness.
answer_roles.observed: All five candidates win in the same bank and order, independently tested across 15 banks before and after delivery. IC-only evidence leaves at least two candidates.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Both signs with nonzero admissible ordinate, per q-128199 branch-selection solution.
answer_roles.observed: Fresh negative/positive cases and retained four signed/magnitude cases pass native checks; no branch is removed.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: The same solution family may be written using argument fragments differing by any additive constant.
answer_roles.observed: Stored key is correct, but native grader rejects equivalent x²-6x and (x-3)²+1 in exact delivered batch. This is the separate grading finding.

coverage.case: Changed trig finite profiles and every winning role
coverage.result: 75/75 roles mathematically unique and survive delivery. Visible-bank-only choices succeed at 1/5, including pure-pi² subgroup.

coverage.case: Retained exact failures and small unchanged regression
coverage.result: Original symbol and conditional cues reproduced on earlier packages and defeated currently; restored source families and repaired native root/log cases pass their old strict checks.

coverage.case: Exact runner batch and actual delivery survivors
coverage.result: 5/5 survive captured-inventory filtering; four blank families and no trig item. Keys correct; valid sine family-equivalent submissions rejected.

counterfactuals.change: Keep complete trig bank, order, ODE, initial abscissa and interval fixed; change only initial ordinate by pi²/2.
counterfactuals.expected: Response constant changes by pi²/2; former key remains a real wrong choice. Prompt, solution and native grading must follow.
counterfactuals.observed: counterfactual records 0 and 1 have identical ODE/bank/order, constant difference pi²/2; final solutions match independently; native accepts each new own key and rejects the other candidate. Both rendered.
counterfactuals.justification: q-104065 substitutes initial data to solve C; an initial ordinate is an eligible answer-bearing assignment.

counterfactuals.change: Keep complete bank and initial condition fixed; change ODE polynomial coefficient.
counterfactuals.expected: Winning coefficient/constant must change while retaining initial value.
counterfactuals.observed: counterfactual records 2 and 3 preserve IC; solutions differ by (x-4)²-pi²/4. Both satisfy their ODE/IC uniquely, are accepted by native, and their cross-candidates rejected. Both rendered.
counterfactuals.justification: Integration of the linear term determines the quadratic coefficient; source constants do not fix the qualifying bank role.

counterfactuals.change: Find -> Determine and reverse answer array, preserving mathematical data and choice UUIDs.
counterfactuals.expected: Same mathematical answer, explanation and native choice outcomes.
counterfactuals.observed: counterfactual record 4 preserves record 0 key UUID and solution. Own-key acceptance and every wrong-choice rejection unchanged; actual UI screenshots 6 and 10 show same relation with changed wording/order.
counterfactuals.justification: Source task assesses integration and initial data, not option order or the instruction verb.

stages_examined: Generator finite selection and rejection rules; direct role choice has no key-dependent resampling
Shared publisher normalization, stable identities and inventory/within-batch deduplication
Learner freshness, configured weighted bands and uniform within-band selection rules; read-only captured-pool conditional reproduction
Actual UI answer-order transformation and rendered controls
delivery.result: All 75 changed-role controls survive; easy 84->83 (one duplicate), moderate 5->5, exact batch 5->5. Source and inventory basis 5372. No publication preparation exists. Positive-weight fresh easy selection supports every accepted easy item; zero weights/history may exclude items, without changing their keys.

limitations: Targeted revision review reuses confirmed unchanged prior independent analysis; no second exhaustive audit of unchanged families.
Live learner histories, exact future entity IDs and policy weights are unavailable; selection conclusion is conditional on explicit captured fresh-pool assumptions.
Finite probes do not prove absence of every imaginable shortcut. Passing decision variation is separate from the demonstrated sine response-equivalence grading failure.
